title: xdrip on oneplus 5 with ticwatch pro
body:
lately i tried using stand alone, didnt work anymore, tried few things unistalled reinstalled, now nothing works except NFC.  looking in the log i get continual "got null pointer trying to set cccd descriptor".  miao manages to get connected but shortly after (minutes), its noted as "not connected".  i click restart connector and its connected again...

in running nov 2 nightly

what should i dooooo? :)

thanks!

comments.body:
got ticwatch pro 3 still not working as standalone... xdrip latest version + libre 1 on miaomiao 2

could anyone help me set it to run standalone?
Please go through the other [ticwatch related issues](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues?q=is%3Aissue+ticwatch). Maybe, there is any hint to get it working.
@paaascal As you mentioned in the other issue that it worked about two years ago, please report back the latest working version. That will help narrowing down the issue.

Isn't this issue a duplicate of #1048 as well, is it? The only exception is the different phone in use. But this is unrelated to the standalone functionality.
Hence, closing it in favor of #1048.
